quotes.text: Moses' final commission is to execute retribution upon the Midianites for having, on the advice of Balaam, incited their women to seduce the Israelites in the licentious rites of Baal-peor, as recorded in 25:17-19. Moses musters a small army of twelve thousand men (or twelve divisions), one thousand men (or one division) from each tribe. The army annihilates the Midianites without suffering a single casualty.
quotes.speaker: Jacob Milgrom
quotes.attr: Jacob Milgrom, The JPS Torah Commentary: Numbers, Philadelphia, 1989, 255
